events.description: Opinion issued by court as to Appellants Edward Metz and Sarah E. Thompson. Decision: Dismissed. Opinion type: Non-Published. Opinion method: Per Curiam. Motion to compel filed by Appellant Sarah E. Thompson is DENIED as MOOT. [10363324-2]; Motion to dismiss appeal for lack of jurisdiction filed by Appellees Georgia Secretary of State and Governor of the State of Georgia is GRANTED. [10358631-2]; Motion to dismiss appeal as moot filed by Appellees Georgia Secretary of State and Governor of the State of Georgia is GRANTED. [10358631-3]. (See 03/03/2025 opinion)(JP/BCG/ALB) The opinion is also available through the Court's Opinions page at this link http://www.ca11.uscourts.gov/opinions .
